method: Independent packet-only addendum. The only file read in this recheck was the updated BLIND_CASES.json. Comparison used the prior blind annotation already present in this conversation; no gold, author, source, or other-model files were read. Initial review files were preserved.

changed_annotations.proof: D1 explicitly establishes that under align the unset prefix-match-unit defaults to the block size, leaving no sub-block boundary and making the checkpoint flag ineffective. D2 establishes divisibility by every prefix-cacheable KV-group block size and startup validation. Both passages are needed for the full conjunction.

changed_annotations.scope_note: These are necessary restrictions, not an assertion that any divisor alone makes the checkpoint effective; D1 lists further prerequisites.

This directly negates the revised claim that those executables are removed from GPU memory rather than staying resident. D1 additionally establishes the enabled pool-offload context but is not needed to negate this explicit removal assertion.
changed_annotations.resolved_ambiguity: Remaining resident is logically incompatible with the revised removal claim; the earlier possibility of making a redundant CPU copy while retaining residency no longer matters.

D1 states that the chosen value must be a multiple of the per-state compression ratio when the model uses one. changed_annotations.scope_note: D1 alone remains insufficient to attach the numerical rule to the named Mamba setting. The sufficient proof must include D2.
